objectives.text: Correct the off‑by‑one error in `catalog.pagination.paginate` so that each page contains exactly the requested number of items without overlapping items between consecutive pages.
Add a test that verifies the last item of a page does not appear as the first item of the next page.

acceptance_criteria.text: Running the full test suite (`pytest`) passes with no failures, confirming that existing behavior (including `page_count` and argument validation in `paginate`) is preserved.

`paginate` returns exactly `per_page` items when enough items are available, and fewer only when the remaining items are insufficient, without the extra item caused by the previous `end = start + per_page + 1` logic.

A new test (e.g., `test_no_duplicate_across_pages`) asserts that for a list of at least `2 * PER_PAGE` items, the last product of page `n` is not equal to the first product of page `n+1` for all valid pages.
